slides.title: Ethiopians have crossed into Kenya from Moyale
Update from aid groups
slides.body: Humanitarian officials gave the new figure, TRT World and Anadolu reported on Oct 24.

slides.title: people in six temporary camps
slides.body: in Moyale, Kenya, the Kenya Red Cross said. About 4,000 more are staying with host families.

slides.title: What families need
slides.body: The Kenya Red Cross appealed for food, clean water and sanitation to prevent disease in the camps.
